originals.citation: Mahon, J. N., Winston, A. P., Palmer, R. L., & Harvey, P. K. (2001). Do broken relationships in childhood relate to bulimic women breaking off psychotherapy in adulthood? International Journal of Eating Disorders, 29(2), 139-149.

quote: The primary goal of this study was to replicate the finding that experiences of childhood trauma have a dose-effect relationship with dropping out from psychotherapeutic treatment for bulimia nervosa. It also aimed to replicate logistic regression findings that parental break-up predicts dropping out. ... LR models were double cross-validated between this and an earlier cohort.
notes: Self-replication; the earlier cohort paper's abstract (Europe PMC) reports exactly the dose-effect trauma finding and parental break-up predictor.
